description: This file defines the Zend_Validate_EmailAddress class, which validates email addresses according to RFC2822, including hostname and MX record checks, and local part format validation.

classes.name: Zend_Validate_EmailAddress
classes.description: A class for validating email addresses, including syntax, hostname validity, and optional MX record existence.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the email address validator with hostname validation options and MX check setting.

methods.name: setHostnameValidator
methods.description: Sets or replaces the hostname validator object used internally.

methods.name: validateMxSupported
methods.description: Checks if the system supports DNS MX record retrieval via dns_get_mx.

methods.name: setValidateMx
methods.description: Enables or disables MX record validation during email validation.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates the provided email address string for correct format, hostname validity, and optional MX record existence.
